items.title: # Tailor Your Resume
items.content: Paste the job description and your resume into an AI. Ask it to highlight keywords and suggest improvements to align your experience. This makes your application stand out.

items.title: # Practice Interview Questions
items.content: Ask AI to generate common interview questions for your target role. Practice your answers aloud. You can even ask the AI for feedback on your responses.

items.title: # Research Companies Faster
items.content: Give AI a company's website or recent news articles. Ask it to summarize their mission, recent projects, and culture. This helps you show genuine interest.

items.title: # Draft Thank You Notes
items.content: After an interview, provide AI with key discussion points. Ask it to draft a personalized thank-you email. This shows professionalism and reinforces your fit.

items.title: # Tailor Your Resume
items.content: Paste a job description and your resume. Ask AI to highlight gaps or suggest improvements to better match the role. This saves time customizing for each application.

items.title: # Polish Bullet Points
items.content: Provide your resume bullet points to AI. Ask it to rephrase them using stronger action verbs and quantifiable results. This makes your achievements more impactful.

items.title: # Draft Cover Letters
items.content: Give AI the job description and your resume. Request a draft cover letter highlighting relevant skills and experiences. Always review and personalize it before sending.

items.title: # Proofread For Errors
items.content: Paste your entire resume into an AI tool. Ask it to check for grammar, spelling, and punctuation mistakes. A polished resume shows attention to detail.

items.title: # Content Idea Generator
items.content: Stuck on what to post? Ask AI to brainstorm fresh content ideas for your social media, blog, or email campaigns based on your niche and audience. It saves time and sparks creativity.

items.title: # Draft Social Posts
items.content: Generate quick drafts for social media captions across different platforms. Provide your key message and target audience, and AI will create engaging text ready for a quick review.

items.title: # Rewrite Marketing Copy
items.content: Improve your existing marketing text. Ask AI to rephrase headlines, product descriptions, or ad copy to be more compelling, concise, or to fit a specific tone. Get better results faster.

items.title: # Analyze Customer Feedback
items.content: Quickly understand customer sentiment from reviews or survey responses. AI can summarize common themes and identify key positive or negative feedback, helping you tailor your marketing messages.

items.title: # Brainstorm New Ventures
items.content: Ask AI for innovative business ideas based on your skills or market gaps. It helps spark creativity and uncover untapped opportunities efficiently.

items.title: # Analyze Market Trends
items.content: Use AI to quickly summarize market reports or identify emerging industry trends. This helps you understand your potential audience and competitive landscape faster.

items.title: # Structure Your Plan
items.content: Get AI to generate a comprehensive outline for your business plan, covering all essential sections. This saves time and ensures you don't miss crucial details.

items.title: # Create Brand Identity
items.content: Have AI suggest catchy business names and memorable slogans for your new venture. It offers diverse options, helping you establish a strong brand presence quickly.

items.title: # Content Idea Generator
items.content: Stuck on what to write? Ask AI to brainstorm fresh ideas for your blog, video, or social media based on a topic you provide. It saves time and sparks creativity instantly.

items.title: # Outline Your Content
items.content: Need a structure for your next article or presentation? AI can quickly generate a detailed outline with key sections and points. This helps organize your thoughts efficiently.

items.title: # Simplify Complex Text
items.content: If your writing is too technical, use AI to rephrase it into simpler, more accessible language for your audience. It makes complex concepts easy to understand for everyone.

items.title: # Create Social Posts
items.content: Quickly generate engaging captions and short posts for social media platforms. Just give AI your main message or a link, and it will craft several options for you.

items.title: # Summarize Meeting Notes
items.content: Use AI to condense lengthy meeting transcripts or notes into key takeaways. This helps you quickly recall decisions and action items without rereading everything.

items.title: # Extract Action Items
items.content: Feed your meeting summary to an AI and ask it to list all action items with assigned owners and deadlines. This ensures nothing is missed and responsibilities are clear.

items.title: # Generate Follow-up Emails
items.content: After a meeting, ask AI to draft a follow-up email based on the summary and action items. This saves time and ensures consistent communication to all participants.

items.title: # Identify Key Decisions
items.content: Upload your meeting minutes and prompt the AI to highlight all major decisions made during the discussion. This makes it easy to track progress and refer back to critical agreements.

items.title: # Summarize Long Emails
items.content: Paste lengthy emails into your AI to get key takeaways instantly. This saves you time by quickly grasping the main points without reading everything.

items.title: # Draft Quick Replies
items.content: Tell your AI the context and what you want to say. It will generate a professional draft, speeding up your response time significantly.

items.title: # Refine Email Tone
items.content: Ask your AI to rewrite a draft to be more formal, friendly, or concise. It helps ensure your message is always clear and appropriate.

items.title: # Brainstorm Email Ideas
items.content: Stuck on what to write? Give your AI a topic and audience, and it will suggest various content angles or subject lines to get you started.
